critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now ~1213 lines and still mixes auth, jobs, poles, exports, files, and gallery HTML in one file - split into routers for maintainability.
Two duplicate startup handlers (@app.on_event('startup')) defined - one for admin seed, one for storage; consolidating into a single async startup would be cleaner.
is_admin_user() has unreachable 'return user' after the boolean return statement (dead code).

Gallery HTML uses inline <style> that hardcodes dark colors (#0a0a0a body, #18181b figures) - inconsistent with the rest of the app now being a bright white theme. Consider switching the gallery page to a light palette for visual consistency.
/api/upload-photo + /api/files/{path} are unauthenticated; uploaded objects are public-readable forever. Acceptable for /Excel links but documented as a tradeoff.
